exploratory_calls_before_the_logger.note: Endpoint-discovery requests made with curl while working out which APIs still exist. They are listed because findings in README.md and readiness.json rest on them: the old SABIO-RK REST path 404ing, SIGNOR being unreachable, BRENDA's website search finding nothing for Danio rerio, the IntAct Lucene fields returning 0, and PaxDb's own statement of its unit. Same generic User-Agent; no personal identifier was sent.

calls.why: the documented SABIO-RK REST path; it now redirects to a 404 page, which is why the new /api/sabio/* API was used instead

second SIGNOR attempt, same failure

no such IntAct endpoint
